senses.gloss:
अचोदनम् Non-injunction, a mere statement (of something already known);
 देशकालानामचोदनं प्रयोगे नित्यसमवायात् MS. 4. 2. 23.

अचोविनः (?) Probably a special messenger to report among other things,
 impending attacks from enemies; Sircar, SI. 239 n.

अचोदस् a. Ved. [नास्ति चोदना यस्य] Spontaneous, not influenced
 by external force or compulsion. अचोदसो न धन्वन्त्विन्दवः Rv. 9. 79. 1.
